item.title: Bulletin updated at 06:30 HKT 09/Feb/2023
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
An easterly airstream will affect the coast of southern China in the next couple of days. The weather will be misty with one or two rain patches over the region. Under the influence of a warm and humid maritime airstream, it will be foggy over the coast of Guangdong early next week. A cold front is expected to move across the coast of Guangdong between next Monday night and next Tuesday morning. It will become appreciably cooler and windier over the region.

Date/Month: 09/02 (Thursday)
Wind: East force 4 to 5, occasionally force 6 offshore and on high ground at first.
Weather: Mainly cloudy with one or two light rain patches. It will be misty in the morning and at night.
Temp range: 17 - 21 C
R.H. range: 80 - 95 per Cent
PSR: Low
